verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's `init` writes plain SKILL.md files into standard folder layouts for two harnesses (Codex `.agents/skills` and Claude Code `.claude/skills`), and the docs say these files can be committed and shared, so the skill wrapper is portable markdown. However, the actual process guides are retrieved from a hosted, login-gated service rather than shipped as local markdown files, so the substance of the skills does not travel as plain files. Missing for 10: evidence of the SKILL.md contents being self-contained readable instructions, process guides available as local markdown files rather than hosted retrieval, portability beyond Codex and Claude Code, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: You can commit the skill files to share the setup with your team.
The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
The second writes the selected skill files.
